backend.description: Name or path of the gpgv implementation used as backend.

mode.description: The subcommand to execute: 'verify' for detached signatures or 'inline-verify' for inline signatures.

certs.description: List of paths to Acceptable OpenPGP Certificates for signature verification.

signature_file.description: Path to the OpenPGP signature file (required for 'verify' mode).

not_before.description: Only accept signatures created later than this timestamp. Empty string implies no restriction.

not_after.description: Only accept signatures created earlier than this timestamp. Empty string implies no restriction (defaults to now).

verifications_out.description: File path to write SOP-style VERIFICATIONS output. Empty implies stdout.
